title: Mushroom Neural Orb
description: A glowing spherical apparatus sits on a metallic base, containing a central orb emitting yellow branching energy that connects to turquoise mushrooms, blue birds, and a small brown mouse holding a sparkling wand. A human finger with a purple nail touches the sphere from the right, sending pink and blue light beams into the scene against a dark cloudy night sky.
